engine.name: Modor NF-1k
engine.description: Modor NF-1k polyphonic synthesizer: every setting of the manual's MIDI controller list, with the preset vowels on the formant controllers.

sources.title: Modor NF-1k user manual, version 1 for firmware OS001
sources.notes: The MIDI controller list (PDF pages 75 - 77) and the formant table, read by tools/profiles/modor/read-modor-manual.mjs from UsersManualNF-1k.pdf (sha256 5d397fe445e8af22387fd4b1ba7825ef64ba0c9741a0a7f0855006375adf2ccb), https://modormusic.com/downloads/UsersManualNF-1k.pdf, linked from https://modormusic.com/downloads.html. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/modor/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/modor/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI controller list that it marks Received, sent as its controller on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Each is sent 0 - 127: the manual gives the panel's ranges (`[0,127]`, `[-64,+63]`, coarse tuning `[-32,+31]`) but not how a controller's value maps onto them.

Left out, and named: the performance controllers, Modulation wheel (CC 1), Breath Controller (MSB) (CC 2), Modulation CC3 (MSB) (CC 3), Expression Pedal (CC 4), Sustain pedal (CC 64); MIDI's own, Bank select (CC 32), All notes off (CC 123); the rows the list prints as not received, Breath Controller (LSB) (CC 34), Modulation CC3 (LSB) (CC 35).

coverage.editBufferDumpParse: notImplemented: the manual describes SysEx dumps without their format
coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends the controllers the list marks Transmitted when its knobs turn; not mapped
